blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — The Supreme Court’s ruling against unprogrammed appropriations in previous national budgets has vindicated the late Albay Rep. Edcel Lagman’s challenge to the controversial budget mechanism. In a statement on Thursday, Albay Rep. Krisel Lagman, Edcel’s daughter, welcomed the high court’s Oct. 7 decision, which ruled unconstitutional Congress’ P449.5-billion increase in unprogrammed appropriations in the 2024 national budget and a P17.99-billion increase in the Department of Public Works and Highways’ Special Road Fund in the 2025 budget. Her late father’s petition had questioned the increase in unprogrammed appropriations from P281.9 billion in the President’s proposed National Expenditure Program to […]...
